mapper.sql: AGENT_INSTITUTION_CODE AGENT_INSTITUTION_CODE, ISSUE_PARTY_ID ISSUE_PARTY_ID, PROD_ID PROD_ID, PROD_NAME PROD_NAME, PROD_REGIST_CODE PROD_REGIST_CODE, STATUS STATUS, DATA_DATE DATA_DATE, REMARK REMARK, CREATE_USER CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME UPDATE_TIME
mapper.select:
select a.AGENT_INSTITUTION_CODE agentInstitutionCode, b.AGENT_INSTITUTION_NAME agentInstitutionName, a.ISSUE_PARTY_ID issuePartyId, a.STATUS status, a.PROD_ID prodId, a.PROD_NAME prodName, a.PROD_REGIST_CODE prodRegistCode, a.REMARK remark from CHB_AGENT_PRD_INFO a left join CHB_AGENT_INSTITUTION_INFO b on a.AGENT_INSTITUTION_CODE = b.AGENT_INSTITUTION_CODE where 1=1
and a.STATUS = #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and a.AGENT_INSTITUTION_CODE like concat(concat('%',#{agentInstitutionCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%')
and a.PROD_ID like concat(concat('%',#{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%')
and a.PROD_REGIST_CODE like concat(concat('%',#{prodRegistCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%')

select a.AGENT_INSTITUTION_CODE agentInstitutionCode, b.AGENT_INSTITUTION_NAME agentInstitutionName, a.ISSUE_PARTY_ID issuePartyId, a.PROD_REGIST_CODE prodRegistCode, a.REMARK remark from CHB_AGENT_PRD_INFO a left join CHB_AGENT_INSTITUTION_INFO b on a.AGENT_INSTITUTION_CODE = b.AGENT_INSTITUTION_CODE where a.AGENT_INSTITUTION_CODE = #{agentInstitutionCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.PROD_REGIST_CODE = #{prodRegistCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.update: UPDATE CHB_AGENT_PRD_INFO SET STATUS = 'D' where AGENT_INSTITUTION_CODE = #{agentInstitutionCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and PROD_REGIST_CODE = #{prodRegistCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.select: select count(*) from CHB_AGENT_PRD_INFO where STATUS = 'D' and AGENT_INSTITUTION_CODE = #{agentInstitutionCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and PROD_REGIST_CODE = #{prodRegistCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select AGENT_INSTITUTION_CODE agentInstitutionCode, PROD_REGIST_CODE prodRegistCode from CHB_AGENT_PRD_INFO where STATUS = 'D'
select AGENT_INSTITUTION_CODE agentInstitutionCode, PROD_REGIST_CODE prodRegistCode from CHB_AGENT_PRD_INFO where STATUS = 'E'
select count(*) from CHB_AGENT_PRD_INFO where STATUS = 'E' and AGENT_INSTITUTION_CODE = #{agentInstitutionCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and PROD_REGIST_CODE = #{prodRegistCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select count(*) from CHB_AGENT_INSTITUTION_INFO where STATUS = 'E' and AGENT_INSTITUTION_CODE = #{agentInstitutionCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select AGENT_INSTITUTION_NAME agentInstitutionName from CHB_AGENT_INSTITUTION_INFO where AGENT_INSTITUTION_CODE = #{agentInstitutionCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.insert: insert into CHB_AGENT_PRD_INFO (AGENT_INSTITUTION_CODE, ISSUE_PARTY_ID, PROD_ID, PROD_NAME, PROD_REGIST_CODE, STATUS, DATA_DATE, REMARK, CREATE_DEPT, ORG_CODE, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME) select * from (select TEMP.* from ( SELECT #{agentInstitutionCode} AGENT_INSTITUTION_CODE, #{issuePartyId} ISSUE_PARTY_ID, #{prodId} PROD_ID, #{prodName} PROD_NAME, #{prodRegistCode} PROD_REGIST_CODE, #{status} STATUS, now() DATA_DATE, #{remark} REMARK, #{createDept} CREATE_DEPT, #{orgCode} ORG_CODE, now() CREATE_TIME, now() UPDATE_TIME from dual ) TEMP where not EXISTS( select 1 from CHB_AGENT_PRD_INFO a where a.AGENT_INSTITUTION_CODE = TEMP.AGENT_INSTITUTION_CODE AND a.PROD_REGIST_CODE = TEMP.PROD_REGIST_CODE ) ) a; update CHB_AGENT_PRD_INFO a,( select * from (select TEMP.* from ( SELECT #{agentInstitutionCode} AGENT_INSTITUTION_CODE, #{issuePartyId} ISSUE_PARTY_ID, #{prodId} PROD_ID, #{prodName} PROD_NAME, #{prodRegistCode} PROD_REGIST_CODE, #{status} STATUS, now() DATA_DATE, #{remark} REMARK, #{createDept} CREATE_DEPT, #{orgCode} ORG_CODE, now() CREATE_TIME, now() UPDATE_TIME from dual ) TEMP ) a ) b set a.ISSUE_PARTY_ID = b.ISSUE_PARTY_ID, a.PROD_ID = b.PROD_ID, a.PROD_NAME = b.PROD_NAME, a.STATUS = b.STATUS, a.DATA_DATE = b.DATA_DATE, a.REMARK = b.REMARK, a.CREATE_DEPT = b.CREATE_DEPT, a.ORG_CODE = b.ORG_CODE, a.CREATE_TIME = b.CREATE_TIME, a.UPDATE_TIME = b.UPDATE_TIME where a.AGENT_INSTITUTION_CODE = b.AGENT_INSTITUTION_CODE and a.PROD_REGIST_CODE = b.PROD_REGIST_CODE
mapper.select: select a.REG_CODE prodRegistCode, a.PRODID prodId, b.PROD_NAME prodName FROM CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE a LEFT JOIN chb_prd_baseinfo b ON b.prod_id = a.PRODID
select a.PRODID prodId, b.PROD_NAME prodName FROM CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE a LEFT JOIN chb_prd_baseinfo b ON b.prod_id = a.PRODID where a.REG_CODE = #{prodRegistCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select AGENT_INSTITUTION_CODE agentInstitutionCode from CHB_AGENT_INSTITUTION_INFO where status = 'E'

SELECT distinct(a.AGENT_INSTITUTION_CODE) code, b.AGENT_INSTITUTION_NAME name, b.AGENT_INSTITUTION_NAME shortName, a.AGENT_INSTITUTION_CODE hidCode from CHB_AGENT_PRD_INFO a left join CHB_AGENT_INSTITUTION_INFO b on a.AGENT_INSTITUTION_CODE = b.AGENT_INSTITUTION_CODE
AND (a.AGENT_INSTITUTION_CODE like concat('%',concat(#{agentInstitutionCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')) or b.AGENT_INSTITUTION_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{agentInstitutionCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')))

SELECT distinct(PROD_ID) code, PROD_NAME name, PROD_NAME shortName, PROD_ID hidCode FROM CHB_AGENT_PRD_INFO
AND (PROD_ID like concat('%',concat(#{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')) or PROD_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')))

SELECT distinct(PROD_REGIST_CODE) code FROM CHB_AGENT_PRD_INFO
AND PROD_REGIST_CODE like concat('%',concat(#{prodRegistCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%'))

SELECT AGENT_INSTITUTION_CODE id, AGENT_INSTITUTION_CODE text from CHB_AGENT_INSTITUTION_INFO
and AGENT_INSTITUTION_CODE like concat(concat('%', #{search}),'%')

1=1
and a.REG_CODE like concat(concat('%', #{search}),'%')
